attributes.name: separation_technique
attributes.definition: The primary visual mechanism used to separate sections, cards or regions on the page.

values.definition: Separation is achieved mainly with thin (e.g. 1px) borders or hairlines on elements or section edges.
Thin borders combined with background-tone differences between panels.
Separation achieved through spacing alone, without lines or shadows.

attributes.name: shadow_usage
attributes.definition: Whether box or drop shadows are used on the page.

values.definition: No box-shadows or drop shadows are used.
Shadows are used on some elements.

attributes.name: gradient_and_transition_usage
attributes.definition: Whether gradients and transitions/animations are used.

values.definition: No gradients or transitions are used.

attributes.name: divider_element_style
attributes.definition: How dividers between content areas are implemented.

values.definition: Separate horizontal rule elements divide content.
Dividing lines are borders on cards or section edges, not hr elements.
Thin hairline lines used as rules generally.
